Ask the box's owner to share a port as a preview link (for agents on a box).

Usage: termag preview request <port> [--note <text>]

Run it in a workstream's checkout on its box. The owner sees the request in the project's Share
dialog and on Slack, and publishes it (for them and the project's collaborators only, to start with) or
declines it. It waits 24 hours.
--note says what the port is, up to 200 characters; the owner sees it as your words.
A box can ask 10 times an hour. Asking again for the same port says where the request stands: still
waiting, or published, declined or expired, and when. Once it was answered, the owner isn't asked again
for 12 hours, so don't ask again in a loop.
  termag preview request 5173 --note "the Vite dev server for the checkout page"

Global flags:
  --json          Machine-readable output
  --yes           Skip confirmations
  --host <url>    Orchestrator to use (or TERMAG_URL). Default: the production orchestrator,
                  or this box's own orchestrator when run on a box
  -h, --help      Show help
  --version       Show the version

Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 3 not found, 4 auth needed, 5 timeout.
